description: Managed-home layout for active-worktree resolution: primary worktrees, one existing linked worktree, one removed linked worktree and one app that was never cloned. Materialized into a temporary directory by the test (a checked-in .git directory would be an embedded repository).

cases.alpha: active worktree feature/x, linked directory exists -> linked checkout
cases.beta: active worktree feature/gone, linked directory removed -> primary fallback
cases.gamma: active worktree trunk equals the main worktree branch -> primary checkout
cases.delta: no runtime state row -> primary checkout
